lead: Cook your own paella, have dinner with live flamenco, take a boat trip on the Albufera or discover the wines of Utiel-Requena. The best Valencian flavours turned into unique experiences.
Paella workshop and dinner with a flamenco show: the most popular food experiences within the city.

items.title: Dinner with a flamenco tablao in València
items.subtitle: Dinner + live flamenco show · Wednesday to Sunday · Rated 4.8/5
items.body: A unique night in Valencia that blends the best Mediterranean cuisine with a live flamenco tablao show. The 2-hour-30-minute experience combines a dinner of Valencian and Spanish products and recipes with a professional flamenco performance — dance, song and guitar — that fills the evening with emotion and colour. Available from Wednesday to Sunday, it is the perfect plan for a special night in Valencia: a celebration, a romantic date or simply a different way to discover two of the great passions of Spanish culture brought together in one place.

items.title: Live the Paella Experience: learn to cook our way
items.subtitle: Cook the paella yourself · Local ingredients · Tasting included · 10% off with VTC · 5/5
items.body: Learn to prepare authentic Valencian paella from local chefs in an interactive, hands-on workshop of 2 hours 30 minutes. The Paella Experience begins at 11:00 with the selection of ingredients and an explanation of the history and secrets of Spain’s most famous dish: the rice, the meat, the vegetables, the saffron and the sofrito that make the difference between a mediocre paella and an extraordinary one. Each participant cooks their own paella and tastes it at the end of the workshop. An experience that lets you take home not only the flavour, but also the technique and knowledge to reproduce it.

items.title: Boat trip and paella in l’Albufera
items.subtitle: Traditional boat trip · Paella in a lakeside restaurant · Spanish · 4.9/5 · 168 reviews
items.body: The most popular food experience in Valencia and one of the highest rated, with 4.9 out of 5 and 168 reviews. The plan combines a traditional boat trip around the Albufera Natural Park — the largest lake in Spain and the historic cradle of Valencian paella — with an authentic paella in a restaurant facing the lake. The excursion lasts between 3 and 4 hours, departs at 12:45 every day of the year and is guided in Spanish. The boat travels the canals between the rice fields while the guide explains the history and ecology of the park, and afterwards you enjoy the paella as close to its origin as possible: in the very setting where this dish was born centuries ago.

items.title: Albufera Tourist Bus with boat trip and paella menu
items.subtitle: Transport from Valencia · Boat + paella included · Monday to Saturday · Multilingual audio guide · 4.7/5
items.body: The most complete version of the Albufera excursion: Valencia’s tourist bus picks visitors up in the city, takes them to the Albufera Natural Park and combines the traditional boat trip on the lake with a paella menu in a local restaurant. The excursion lasts between 4 and 6 hours and is available from Monday to Saturday. The bus includes a multilingual audio guide during the journey. A perfect option for those without their own vehicle or who prefer the convenience of an all-inclusive service that combines transport, nature and Valencian cuisine in one hassle-free plan.

items.title: Utiel-Requena: winery tasting, cultural visit and lunch
items.subtitle: D.O. Utiel-Requena tasting · Historic winery · Cultural visit to Requena · Lunch included · Every day
items.body: The most complete food experience from Valencia: a whole day of wine tourism in the Utiel-Requena region, the main wine-growing area of the Comunitat Valenciana. The 7-hour excursion includes return transport, a guided visit to the medieval town of Requena with its underground wineries and its historic centre declared a Historic-Artistic Site, a wine tasting with the Utiel-Requena Designation of Origin — internationally known for the Bobal grape — and a lunch with wine pairing included. Available every day in Spanish and English. The perfect combination of culture, history and gastronomy just 70 km from Valencia.

blocks.title: Tips for choosing your food experience in Valencia
items: The Boat trip and paella in the Albufera experience (€26) is the best value of the whole range: it combines nature, culture and authentic cuisine in just 3–4 hours
The Paella Experience (€62) is the most hands-on option: if you really want to understand Valencian paella, there is nothing better than cooking it yourself under the supervision of a local chef
Dinner with a flamenco tablao (€75) is perfect for a special night: always book Friday or Saturday to enjoy the most festive atmosphere of the show
The version with the Albufera Tourist Bus (€39) is ideal if you do not have a car: all inclusive, with no need to organise your own transport

The excursion to Utiel-Requena (€195) is the most expensive but also the most complete: wine tourism, medieval history and lunch with wine pairing in a single day, perfect for groups of friends or couples
Always book ahead at weekends: the Paella Experience and the flamenco dinner often fill up on Fridays and Saturdays, especially from May to September
